name: get_cloud_import_compatibility
title: Get cloud import compatibility
description: Check whether a cloud export package can be imported: returns the running app version, the latest applied migration, and the cloud-import schema versions the API accepts. Anonymous preflight endpoint; no project scope or credential needed. Use before preparing a migration to confirm the export schema is still supported.

name: get_provider_rates
title: Get provider rates
description: List public provider rate cards used for rank-check cost estimates. Each rate card is either flat-priced (per-check options such as standard, priority, live) or plan-priced (monthly plans with included checks). Anonymous endpoint; no project scope needed.

name: get_cost_estimate
title: Get cost estimate
description: Estimate rank checks, result pages, and monthly provider cost for a keyword portfolio. Provide keywords, markets (locations), devices (1-2), and depth (10, 20, 50, or 100; default 100). Frequency supports daily, weekly, monthly, manual, paused, and custom_cron with cron_expression. Missing or invalid custom cron leaves monthly quantities and costs unknown. Pick a provider (default dataforseo) and optionally an option or plan key; see get_provider_rates. Anonymous endpoint.

devices.description: Device count per keyword (1 or 2). Defaults to 1.

frequency.description: Rank-check frequency used to estimate monthly checks. Defaults to daily.

locations.description: Market count per keyword; each market combines a location and language. Defaults to 1.

option.description: Flat-rate provider option key, for example "standard", "priority", or "live".

plan.description: Plan-model provider plan key; unknown values use auto selection.

provider.description: Provider rate card to use. Defaults to "dataforseo".

depth.description: Organic result depth. Defaults to Top 100.

cron_expression.description: Cron expression for custom_cron; missing or invalid values leave monthly estimates unknown.

name: get_project_defaults

description: Get the effective rank-check schedule and SERP market defaults for a project. name: update_project_defaults
title: Update project defaults
description: Update the project default rank-check schedule, SERP depth, and SERP market. The schedule is replaced as a whole: omitted schedule fields (frequency, cron_expression, jitter_minutes, timezone) reset to their defaults (jitter 60, timezone UTC, no cron). serp_depth and serp_stop_on_match are independent of the schedule and keep their stored values when omitted. Provide country and device together, or a location_key, to move the default SERP market. Use search_locations and pass its location_key verbatim to preserve the exact location-language pair.

name: list_keywords
title: List project keywords
description: List the tracked keywords (search terms) of a project with their current rankings: latest_position, previous_position, ranking_url, target URL, tags, schedule, and market. Supports pagination, search, filters, and sorting. Use it for rank positions, rank tracking, keyword rankings, and SERP position lookups. Each keyword includes location_key, language_code, and language_label for its exact market pair. latest_position can be null after a failed check, with unknown observation coverage, or for absence within the requested depth. Read latest_check.status and observation_completeness. Only complete coverage supports absence within depth; a positive position remains valid with truncated coverage. latest_successful_check is the most recent completed observation and can also have unknown coverage.

name: analyze_backlinks
title: Analyze backlinks
description: Requires API write scope because cache misses spend the project's own DataForSEO budget. Successful snapshots contain summary metrics and per-link rows with new or lost status. Optional 12-month history may be unavailable: history_unavailable marks a history failure with confirmed cost while summary and links remain available. With unknown accounting, the response remains failed (isError) and may retain a completed summary as current-response evidence, with cost_cents null and rows_status not_requested. This evidence is not a cached snapshot or a settled total and does not survive reload. Successful snapshots are cached for 24 hours. Call with estimate_only first for a free dry run, then use max_cost_cents as a best-effort request guard. Compute aggregate views from rows and treat them as "within fetched rows" only.

name: connect_provider
title: Connect provider
description: Connect or update credentials for a project provider. SERP providers are dataforseo and serpapi; analytics providers are ga4, gsc, and plausible. For Plausible, credentials.login is the site domain configured in Plausible (site_id, for example example.com) and defaults to the project domain when omitted; credentials.api_key is the Stats API token. Self-hosted providers such as Plausible accept an optional credentials.endpoint base URL. Use priority for ordering (0 promotes the provider to primary and renumbers the rest; omitted keeps a reconnected provider's place and appends a new one); the deprecated primary=true alias promotes priority 0 and primary=false is a no-op.
